method:
QA of the four founder-approved files AS NOW SHIPPED in assets/ (2026-10-17).
Per file: exact manifest file name and FNV-1a fingerprint of the canonical
script; provenance (logged voice ID and script of the source take); script
identity by offline ASR (faster-whisper small.en) on the shipping .m4a;
lead-in, tail, last 10 ms, true peak; and that the file IS the approved
performance (waveform correlation of the decoded shipping speech against its
source take, trimmed and at the logged gain).
Brittney part_sitAMinute (c3 starts on its first sample): where the initial
"S" frication starts and how long it lasts before voicing, in the raw take
and in the shipping file, against the two other seeds and the seed-30 take;
and how much of the first 100 ms the 2 ms head fade removes.
Usage: python -I applied_qa.py <repo>

voice_brittney_v1/part_sitAMinute.script: Sit for a minute. Sit still for a minute or two before you move on. There’s nothing to do.
voice_brittney_v1/part_sitAMinute.asr: Sit for a minute. Sit still for a minute or two before you move on. There's nothing to do.

voice_heather_v1/part_gentleStretch.script: Gentle stretch. Slowly: neck, shoulders, open the chest, a seated twist, then fold forward and come up slowly. Only what’s comfortable.
voice_heather_v1/part_gentleStretch.asr: Gentle stretch. Slowly. Neck, shoulders. Open the chest. A seated twist. Then fold forward and come up slowly. Only what's comfortable.

voice_heather_v1/part_getItOut.script: Get it out. Write down everything on your mind, without sorting. When you run dry, ask what else is nagging at you.
voice_heather_v1/part_getItOut.asr: Get it out. Write down everything on your mind without sorting. When you run dry, ask what else is nagging at you.

voice_heather_v1/part_oneTask.script: One task, no switching. Pick one task on your mind and put everything else out of sight. Stay with it until the time’s up — finished or not.
voice_heather_v1/part_oneTask.asr: One task, no switching. Pick one task on your mind and put everything else out of sight. Stay with it until the time's up. Finished or not.
